# Fanfarr v0.5.35

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## A board, not a table

The library is now a split-flap departure board in behavior as well as looks:
rows that arrive new or change status cascade in top to bottom while steady
rows sit still, honoring reduced-motion. Matte near-black ground, a condensed
display face for titles, counts and page headings, tabular numerals throughout.

## Small corrections in the same pass

The column picker and the lengths dialog sit inside the screen with a gutter
on phones instead of running edge to edge. `kbd` hints are themed rather than
browser-default.

## Housekeeping

Lucide is pinned to a commit instead of tracking its moving branch -- two
bumps became icon hunts. Usage rules from dependencies now sync to
`USAGE_RULES.md`, leaving the curated `AGENTS.md` alone.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
